prompt: A yogurt brand launched a plant-based line. Sales reached 50% of target, and 70% of buyers were already buyers of the brand's dairy yogurt. Which is the strongest initial hypothesis?

options.text: Sales have probably reached about half of target so far.
options.feedback: This restates the facts without proposing a cause.

options.text: The line likely isn't reaching customers beyond the brand's base.
options.feedback: Right. 70% of buyers already bought the brand, so the line has barely reached new customers, which would explain the shortfall. I'd compare buyers with the target audience.

options.text: The new line is eating into dairy sales, so it should be dropped at once.
options.feedback: This states a cause as certain and jumps to a drastic action before any data.

options.text: The brand's existing customers are likely ignoring the new line.

explanation: The data shows sales at half of target, with 70% of buyers already buying the brand's dairy yogurt. Likely cause: the line isn't reaching customers beyond the brand's base. To test it, compare buyers with the target audience and check awareness among non-buyers. Also check whether these buyers cut their dairy purchases; if they did, the line is cannibalizing dairy as well.
